artifacts_get_source.description: Artifacts get source: verified files of the current or a selected release as `text` (encoding "utf8") or `base64` (encoding "base64"), never an integer array, plus a guideRef instead of the guide body.

artifacts_list_access.description: Artifacts list access: sharing mode, owner and grant list of one artifact, projected to userRefs. The owner and platform admins see every entry; a simple reader sees the mode and its own entry only.

artifacts_list_assets.description: Artifacts list assets: released assets from a manifest, staged assets from committed uploads, optionally filtered by browser upload page. Released listing needs the source read right; staged listing is owner-only.

artifacts_lookup_people.description: Artifacts lookup people: search the host directory by name or email and return opaque userRefs with masked email hints (approved callers only; homonyms are returned, never silently resolved). Use the returned userRef as principalId of artifacts_set_access.

artifacts_publish_bundle.description: Artifacts publish bundle: one atomic release combining inline files with assets whose bytes already left the model (an uploadId staged via artifacts_create_upload + signed PUT + artifacts_commit_upload, or a sha256:<hex> digest of an already-pinned blob). expectedCurrentReleaseId is always required (CAS); null requires an unpublished artifact.
